title: Restricting the Brown adjoint along a proper map to $D^b_{ctf}$
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be admissible and $p\colon X\to Y$ a proper morphism of standing schemes. Then:

1. the functor $Rp_!\colon\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda))\to\Loc(\Dctf(Y,\Lambda))$ of
   [sk-thm-existence] (2) is isomorphic to the restriction of
   $Rp_*\colon D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$;
2. $Rp_*$ maps $\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$ into $\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$, and the restriction of the right
   adjoint $p^!$ of [sk-thm-existence] (3) to $\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$ is a right adjoint
   of $Rp_*\colon\Dctf(X,\Lambda)\to\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$.

proof.text: Use Compactification.ofIsProper p.left for the identity compactification c0 = (id_X,p). Its open immersion is the identity, hence quasi-compact, and its proper part is p. This is the compactification of [def-nagata-compactification] with the given [def-weil-proper-morphism] hypothesis.

For the module pullback of [def-sfb-module-upper-star], the existing proved source-library isomorphism CondensedRing.upperStarId identifies pullback along id_X with the identity. Transport the module adjunction of [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek-adjunction] along this isomorphism. Both extension by zero along id_X and the identity functor are now left adjoint to the identity, so Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq identifies them. Apply Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryIdIso, then whisker by Rp_* and use the left unitor. By [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek] this gives the ambient candidate for c0 isomorphic to Rp_*.

source.place: Paragraph (1): identity extension by zero, using existing module identity and adjunction APIs

proof.text: Apply [sk-thm-existence] with the original standing hypotheses. Its comparison clause gives the chosen lower shriek, followed by the ambient inclusion, isomorphic to the ambient candidate for every compactification. Specialize to c0 and compose with step 2, obtaining beta. The lower shriek membership proof supplied by the caller and beta give preservation of the localizing hull: by [sk-def-localizing-closure], membership is tested in every replete localizing property, and each such property transports membership through beta. Lift the components of beta through the full inclusion to obtain the required natural isomorphism alpha. No separate application of the single-candidate theorem or the coherence cocycle is needed, since their comparison consequence is already a clause of sk-thm-existence.

source.place: Paragraph (1): compactification comparison and replete localizing hulls

proof.text: The same witness of [sk-thm-existence] gives preservation of Dctf by lower shriek, and a Brown right adjoint Gprime preserving Dctf. Use beta and isomorphism invariance from [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude] to prove preservation of Dctf by Rp_*. Membership witnesses h and the witness in sk-thm-existence are propositionally irrelevant, so the two restricted lower-shriek functors agree. The Mathlib leaf [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint], implemented by Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq, identifies Gprime with the supplied G; map its components through the ambient inclusion and transport Dctf membership through these isomorphisms. This proves preservation by the specified G.

source.place: Paragraph (2): preservation of both functors and uniqueness of right adjoints

proof.text: Take hSX and hSY from [sk-thm-existence]. Lift the ambient Rp_* restriction to Dctf using step 4, and lift the composite of the Dctf-to-localizing inclusion, G and the ambient inclusion using preservation by G. By the definitions of ObjectProperty.lift the two required equalities through the full inclusions are reflexive. Whisker alpha with the source Dctf inclusion; the right-adjoint restriction comparison is the identity. Apply Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful to the supplied adjunction using ObjectProperty.fullyFaithfulιOfLE for both inclusions. This constructs the restricted adjunction on the actual ambient Hom sets described in [sk-def-localizing-closure] and [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude].

source.place: Paragraph (2): explicit full-subcategory restrictions and adjunction
